_comment: Committed fixture QUERY embeddings (same 8 concept axes as embeddings.json). Hand-authored so the hybrid (BM25 + fixture-vector -> RRF) ordering is deterministic + explainable in CI with NO embed API. Keyed by the EXACT query string used in the acceptance test + golden tasks. The flagship case is the paraphrase query (G-hybrid): its vector points at axis [5] memory-pressure/eviction so d07 (the eviction doc, which uses SYNONYMS) wins the vector leg, while BM25-alone ranks d08 first (it has the literal query words) — proving hybrid != BM25-alone.
